Title: Microsoft Data Migration Assistant support for SQL Server 2019 is now available

Body.Content:
The latest release of Data Migration Assistant provides support for SQL Server 2019. Upgrade your on-premises SQL Server to SQL Server 2019 by detecting compatibility issues that can impact database functionality on the new version of SQL Server. Data Migration Assistant recommends performance and reliability improvements for your target environment, and it enables the ability to move not only your schema and data, but also uncontained objects from your source server to your target SQL Server 2019.

For more information, see our related documentation.

Read our related documentation

Learn more about Data Migration Assistant
